data.name: Isiah Star
data.detailed_description:
THE MAN OUT OF TIME...

The brave Captain Isiah Star awakens from cryo-sleep and finds himself alone...marooned millions of years in the future, and the last human alive! Awakened by strange, kind creatures crushed by a cosmic crusade of carcinization, our hero is their only hope of escaping eternal crabified slavery at the hands of the all-powerful Carcinoid Confederacy. His comrades a distant memory and his world erased, our heroic human suits up one last time to regain command his craft the "Freebird", and embarks on a galaxy-wide adventure to escape the clutches of the crazed crabs, and deliver the fumbling freedmen to their fabled home of the planet Eden - a lost paradise formerly known as Earth!

Welcome back to the galaxy, captain. A brave new world awaits!!

FEATURES

  • Float like a butterfly with intuitive, simple-to-learn flight controls in this unique over-the-top 3D shoot-em-up adventure. 

  • The power is in YOUR hands - the fearless Captain Star is equipped with bleeding-edge human tech that allows him to upgrade his body and weapon on the fly with unique card-based abilities - collect cards and learn their synergies to fight back YOUR way!

  • You're in command - navigate the cosmos via board-game like tactics-style hub-worlds, where you'll encounter friendlies, anomalies, and hostile forces alike. What happens in the stars determines the battles you'll face in the procedural levels on the ground; move carefully - your lives depend on it!

  • You've only got one life - make it count! Both Isiah and the "Freebird" have persistent health across your play-through; you'll have to choose your encounters carefully if you want to make it home. We need you alive, captain - don't be reckless!
